messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Source link: https://www.mdpi.com/2072-666X/13/10/1650/pdf
Paper DOI: https://doi.org/10.3390/mi13101650

Protocol details:

ASSAY TYPE: Digital Microfluidic RT-qPCR Platform for Multiplex Respiratory Pathogen Detection

Overview: A multi-target RT-qPCR assay protocol executed on a digital microfluidic platform capable of simultaneously dispensing, merging, and amplifying samples to identify up to 11 pathogens from single specimens.

REAGENTS USED:
  - Extracted RNA/DNA Sample (nasal or throat swab nucleic acid extract, 5 uL)
  - RNase-Free Water (6.25 uL)
  - 2x One Step Q Probe Mix (RT-qPCR master mix component, 12.5 uL)
  - One Step Q Probe Enzyme Mix (reverse transcriptase/polymerase enzyme mix, 1.25 uL)
  - 12 Dried Primer-Probe Sets, pre-stored and dehydrated at individual reaction spots on-chip, one per target: MP, CP, SP, RSVA, ADV, HKU1, 229E, HMPV, N (SARS-CoV-2), ORF1ab (SARS-CoV-2), FLUA, FLUB

STEPS:
1. Master Mix Preparation: Dispense 5 uL RNA/DNA sample, 6.25 uL RNase-free water, 12.5 uL 2x One Step Q Probe Mix, and 1.25 uL One Step Q Probe Enzyme Mix; combine sequentially into a single 25 uL RT-qPCR amplification master mix.
2. Droplet Splitting to Reaction Spots: Transport and split the master mix (2 uL per spot) onto each of the 12 on-chip reaction spots, rehydrating the pre-stored dried primer-probe set at each spot to form 12 independent reaction mixtures (one per pathogen target).
3. Reverse Transcription: Heat each of the 12 reaction mixtures at 50 C for 15 min to reverse-transcribe viral/bacterial RNA into cDNA.
4. Initial Denaturation: Heat each of the 12 reaction mixtures at 95 C for 30 s.
5. Thermal Cycling (Amplification): For each of the 12 reaction mixtures independently, cycle 45 times through 95 C for 10 s (denaturation) then 60 C for 30 s (annealing/extension), with real-time fluorescence acquisition during the anneal/extend step of each cycle.
6. Detection: Acquire the real-time fluorescence signal (delta Rn) from each of the 12 reaction spots over the amplification run; a Ct value is computed per spot from the cycle at which fluorescence crosses ten times the standard deviation above the mean baseline (cycles 3-15), and each spot's reading is compared against its corresponding detection-limit threshold to call the sample positive or negative for that target.
7. Disposal: Dispose of each of the 12 analyzed reaction droplets after the amplification/detection run completes.

INTERPRETATION: Successful multiplex detection is confirmed by pathogen-specific amplification curves crossing threshold within 45 cycles for true positives, no amplification (or amplification only after 45 cycles) for true negatives, and reported diagnostic performance (versus off-chip benchtop RT-qPCR) of TPR 93.33%, TNR 100%, PPV 100%, NPV 99.56%, ACC 99.85% (on the plasmid/clinical validation panel), and a Kappa value of 0.963, supporting use of the DMF RT-qPCR platform for field and point-of-care respiratory pathogen screening in medical resource-limited settings.

instructions:

// ---- Prepare common RT-qPCR amplification master mix ----
// 5uL RNA, 6.25uL water, 12.5uL 2x Probe Mix, 1.25uL Probe Enzyme Mix (25uL total)
rna = dispense 5 units of RNA_Sample
water = dispense 6 units of RNase_Free_Water
probemix = dispense 13 units of OneStep_Q_Probe_Mix
enzymemix = dispense 1 units of OneStep_Q_Probe_Enzyme_Mix

mix1 = mix rna with water
mix2 = mix mix1 with probemix
master_mix = mix mix2 with enzymemix

// ---- Split master mix into the 12 reaction spots pre-loaded with dried primer/probe sets ----

mp_probe = dispense MP_Primer_Probe
mp_mix = mix master_mix with mp_probe

cp_probe = dispense CP_Primer_Probe
cp_mix = mix master_mix with cp_probe

sp_probe = dispense SP_Primer_Probe
sp_mix = mix master_mix with sp_probe

rsva_probe = dispense RSVA_Primer_Probe
rsva_mix = mix master_mix with rsva_probe

adv_probe = dispense ADV_Primer_Probe
adv_mix = mix master_mix with adv_probe

hku1_probe = dispense HKU1_Primer_Probe
hku1_mix = mix master_mix with hku1_probe

e229_probe = dispense E229_Primer_Probe
e229_mix = mix master_mix with e229_probe

hmpv_probe = dispense HMPV_Primer_Probe
hmpv_mix = mix master_mix with hmpv_probe

n_probe = dispense N_Primer_Probe
n_mix = mix master_mix with n_probe

orf1ab_probe = dispense ORF1ab_Primer_Probe
orf1ab_mix = mix master_mix with orf1ab_probe

flua_probe = dispense FLUA_Primer_Probe
flua_mix = mix master_mix with flua_probe

flub_probe = dispense FLUB_Primer_Probe
flub_mix = mix master_mix with flub_probe

// ---- Reverse transcription step: 50C for 15m ----
heat mp_mix at 50c for 15m
heat cp_mix at 50c for 15m
heat sp_mix at 50c for 15m
heat rsva_mix at 50c for 15m
heat adv_mix at 50c for 15m
heat hku1_mix at 50c for 15m
heat e229_mix at 50c for 15m
heat hmpv_mix at 50c for 15m
heat n_mix at 50c for 15m
heat orf1ab_mix at 50c for 15m
heat flua_mix at 50c for 15m
heat flub_mix at 50c for 15m

// ---- Initial denaturation: 95C for 30s ----
heat mp_mix at 95c for 30s
heat cp_mix at 95c for 30s
heat sp_mix at 95c for 30s
heat rsva_mix at 95c for 30s
heat adv_mix at 95c for 30s
heat hku1_mix at 95c for 30s
heat e229_mix at 95c for 30s
heat hmpv_mix at 95c for 30s
heat n_mix at 95c for 30s
heat orf1ab_mix at 95c for 30s
heat flua_mix at 95c for 30s
heat flub_mix at 95c for 30s

// ---- 45 cycles of 95C 10s / 60C 30s amplification for each reaction spot ----
repeat 45 times {
    heat mp_mix at 95c for 10s
    heat mp_mix at 60c for 30s
}

repeat 45 times {
    heat cp_mix at 95c for 10s
    heat cp_mix at 60c for 30s
}

repeat 45 times {
    heat sp_mix at 95c for 10s
    heat sp_mix at 60c for 30s
}

repeat 45 times {
    heat rsva_mix at 95c for 10s
    heat rsva_mix at 60c for 30s
}

repeat 45 times {
    heat adv_mix at 95c for 10s
    heat adv_mix at 60c for 30s
}

repeat 45 times {
    heat hku1_mix at 95c for 10s
    heat hku1_mix at 60c for 30s
}

repeat 45 times {
    heat e229_mix at 95c for 10s
    heat e229_mix at 60c for 30s
}

repeat 45 times {
    heat hmpv_mix at 95c for 10s
    heat hmpv_mix at 60c for 30s
}

repeat 45 times {
    heat n_mix at 95c for 10s
    heat n_mix at 60c for 30s
}

repeat 45 times {
    heat orf1ab_mix at 95c for 10s
    heat orf1ab_mix at 60c for 30s
}

repeat 45 times {
    heat flua_mix at 95c for 10s
    heat flua_mix at 60c for 30s
}

repeat 45 times {
    heat flub_mix at 95c for 10s
    heat flub_mix at 60c for 30s
}

// ---- Real-time fluorescence detection on each reaction spot ----
mp_result = detect fluorescence on mp_mix for 10s
cp_result = detect fluorescence on cp_mix for 10s
sp_result = detect fluorescence on sp_mix for 10s
rsva_result = detect fluorescence on rsva_mix for 10s
adv_result = detect fluorescence on adv_mix for 10s
hku1_result = detect fluorescence on hku1_mix for 10s
e229_result = detect fluorescence on e229_mix for 10s
hmpv_result = detect fluorescence on hmpv_mix for 10s
n_result = detect fluorescence on n_mix for 10s
orf1ab_result = detect fluorescence on orf1ab_mix for 10s
flua_result = detect fluorescence on flua_mix for 10s
flub_result = detect fluorescence on flub_mix for 10s

// ---- Threshold-based positive/negative calls (Ct-based cutoff, illustrative threshold) ----
if (mp_result >= 100) {
    dispose mp_mix
}

if (cp_result >= 100) {
    dispose cp_mix
}

if (sp_result >= 100) {
    dispose sp_mix
}

if (rsva_result >= 100) {
    dispose rsva_mix
}

if (adv_result >= 100) {
    dispose adv_mix
}

if (hku1_result >= 100) {
    dispose hku1_mix
}

if (e229_result >= 100) {
    dispose e229_mix
}

if (hmpv_result >= 100) {
    dispose hmpv_mix
}

if (n_result >= 100) {
    dispose n_mix
}

if (orf1ab_result >= 100) {
    dispose orf1ab_mix
}

if (flua_result >= 100) {
    dispose flua_mix
}

if (flub_result >= 100) {
    dispose flub_mix
}

dispose mp_mix
dispose cp_mix
dispose sp_mix
dispose rsva_mix
dispose adv_mix
dispose hku1_mix
dispose e229_mix
dispose hmpv_mix
dispose n_mix
dispose orf1ab_mix
dispose flua_mix
dispose flub_mix

numeric_mismatches.note: The paper transfers 2 uL of the 16 uL loaded amplification mixture to each reaction chamber via automated on-chip pipetting; BioScript has no partial-volume droplet-splitting primitive with fractional carryover, so the full master_mix droplet is modeled as being mixed directly with each spot's primer-probe manifest rather than metered 2 uL sub-aliquots.

The paper's positive/negative call uses a Ct value derived from a dynamic baseline (cycles 3-15, threshold = 10x baseline standard deviation) compared against a target-specific detection limit (12-150 copies/test, Tables 3-4), not a fixed numeric fluorescence cutoff. BioScript's if-statement only supports simple numeric comparison, so a placeholder threshold of 100 is used to represent a generic positive call and should be tuned per assay validation data.

The DMF chip runs all 12 reaction spots in parallel under a single shared thermal cycling program driven by one resistive heater (Section 2.4); BioScript has no primitive for simultaneous multi-droplet heating, so the 45-cycle program is expressed as 12 sequential, functionally identical repeat blocks, one per reaction spot.
